message_types.name: FreezerTelemetry
message_types.description: Cold chain telemetry events for smart cooling systems

properties.name: temperature
properties.description: Current temperature of the freezer in Celsius degrees

properties.name: door_open
properties.description: True if the freezer door is open

properties.name: compressor_current_amps
properties.description: Electrical current drawn by the compressor in Amperes

message_types.name: StorageRiskAssessment
message_types.description: Calibrated System One AI risk assessment generated by TypeSafe Jev for storage assets

properties.name: is_thermal_runaway
properties.description: Whether the freezer exhibits sustained thermal escalation toward vaccine spoilage thresholds (compiled as a System One Noul probability)

properties.name: risk_level
properties.description: Operational risk level determined by System One AI (compiled as a System One Choice primitive)

properties.name: estimated_minutes_to_spoilage
properties.description: Estimated remaining minutes before storage items are spoiled (compiled as a System One Score primitive and scaled to 0..120)

properties.name: recommended_action_code
properties.description: Action code recommendation for floor response (compiled as a System One Choice primitive)

properties.name: root_cause_prediction
properties.description: Deterministic diagnostic summary synthesized by CEL from Jev calibrated decisions and trigger telemetry

properties.name: target_producer
properties.description: Identifier of the target storage asset / producer being analyzed
